metadata.title: TwinO - Autonomous AI Agents for Real Estate
metadata.description: TwinO is an AI Agentic Operating System designed specifically for the real estate industry.

hero.title: Don't lose a lead in real estate. Integrate TwinO with your Meta/WhatsApp
hero.description: It independently filters interested parties in seconds, 24/7, and books your visits.
hero.card2Label: Booked automatically from the same leads
hero.card3Label: Your leads. Your data. Fully isolated.

features.title: Not a Chatbot.
features.subtitle: An Operating System.
features.description: Three specialized AI agents that handle your entire sales pipeline from first message to a confirmed property visit.
features.card1Description: Extracts budget, location, and intent directly from WhatsApp/Meta chats. Qualifies leads in seconds, not hours.
features.card2Description: Automatically syncs qualified leads to your CRM and schedules visits in Google Calendar. Zero manual data entry.
features.card3Description: Your property database and client data are strictly isolated. No one else sees your leads. Full GDPR compliance.

howItWorks.subtitle: Watch how TwinO instantly engages prospects, qualifies their needs, and schedules property tours — all without you lifting a finger.
howItWorks.twinDescription: Automatically responding to all incoming inquiries. Watch as it qualifies leads in real-time.
howItWorks.msg1: Hi, saw the Batumi ad. Is it still available?
howItWorks.msg2: Hello! Yes, it is 🏠 Are you looking for an investment property or for living? And what is your target budget?
howItWorks.msg4: Perfect. We have 2 units in Orbi yielding 11% ROI. Shall I send the PDF breakdown or book a call with our senior agent?

bookDemo.title: Ready to Stop Wasting Your Ad Budget?
